units.source_text: 元旦之晨，天色晴明，长空一碧，了无纤云。

en.t: On the morning of New Year's Day, the weather was clear and bright, the vast sky was pure blue, and not a wisp of cloud could be seen.

units.source_text: 寻常百姓之家，墙根亦有嫩草破雪抽芽。

en.t: Even at the homes of ordinary people, tender grass was breaking through the snow and sprouting along the foot of the walls.

units.source_text: 春云叆叇之中，木叶渐渐萌动。

en.t: Amid the gathering spring clouds, the leaves on the trees were slowly beginning to stir into bud.

units.source_text: 人心自然轻松畅快了。

en.t: People's hearts naturally grew light and cheerful.

units.source_text: 何况琼楼玉宇的六条院，各处庭园，美景甚多。

en.t: All the more so at the jewel-like Rokujo estate, where every garden offered countless beautiful sights.

units.source_text: 诸女主人所居宅院，装饰尤为富丽，作者心欲描述，苦恨言语不够。

en.t: The residences of the various ladies were decorated with exceptional splendor, and though the author longs to describe them, words are sadly inadequate.

units.source_text: 就中首推紫姬所居之春殿：庭前梅蕊飘香，与帘内熏香相交混，

en.t: Foremost among them was the Spring Palace where Lady Murasaki lived: the fragrance of plum blossoms before the garden drifted in and mingled with the incense behind the blinds,

units.source_text: 令人几疑身在现世极乐净土。

en.t: making one almost wonder whether one stood in a Pure Land paradise here in this very world.

units.source_text: 但又不似净土之庄严，可以任情取乐，悠闲度日。

en.t: Yet it was not solemn like the Pure Land; there one could enjoy oneself freely and pass the days at ease.

units.source_text: 优秀的青年侍女，都选去伺候明石小女公子了。

en.t: The most capable young gentlewomen had all been chosen to attend the young Akashi princess.

units.source_text: 留住在此的，只是年龄较长之人。

en.t: Those who remained here were only the older women.

units.source_text: 然而也都伶俐俊秀，容貌、装束等无不楚楚可观。

en.t: Even so, they were all clever and graceful, and their looks, attire, and every other detail were charming to behold.

units.source_text: 她们三五成群地共祝“齿固”，又取出镜饼来吃，

en.t: They gathered in small groups to celebrate the tooth-hardening rite, and brought out mirror cakes to eat,

units.source_text: 唱着“托庇千春”“福寿千春”等古歌，共祝主人家这一年内幸福。

en.t: singing old songs such as 'May we shelter under you for a thousand springs' and 'May fortune and long life last a thousand springs,' as they wished the household happiness for the year.

units.source_text: 正在嬉笑之时，源氏出来了。

en.t: Just as they were laughing and enjoying themselves, Genji came out.

units.source_text: 两手插入怀里的侍女连忙把手伸出，整襟肃立，自觉不好意思。

en.t: The gentlewomen who had tucked both hands into their robes hurriedly drew them out, straightened their collars, stood respectfully, and felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 源氏笑着说：“大家祝我千春，意思太隆重了。

en.t: Genji smiled and said, 'For all of you to wish me a thousand springs is far too grand a sentiment.

units.source_text: 你们每人各有愿望吧，大家讲些给我听听，我也来替你们祝福。”

en.t: Each of you must have wishes of your own; tell me some of them, and I will offer blessings for you too.'

units.source_text: 众侍女在大年初一听到主人这话，大家深感光荣。

en.t: Hearing their master speak this way on New Year's Day, all the gentlewomen felt deeply honored.

units.source_text: 就中那个自命不凡的侍女中将君答道：“我们是在镜饼前‘预祝君侯，福寿千春’。

en.t: Among them, the proud gentlewoman called Chujo answered, 'Before the mirror cakes, we were saying, May our lord enjoy fortune and long life for a thousand springs.

units.source_text: 至于我们自己，别无其他愿望了。”

en.t: As for ourselves, we have no other wishes.'
